story: Suvarnavarsha Gold Ventures Pvt. Ltd. is based at Dange Chowk, Pune. We buy old gold and silver, help customers release gold pledged with banks and other lenders, and sell 24K gold coins and bars.
Selling family gold is an important decision. That is why testing, weighing and pricing all happen in front of you, and we explain every step before you decide.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Suvarnavarsha Gold Ventures Pvt. Ltd. collects through this website and how it is used, in line with India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

sections.title: Information we collect
body: When you send an enquiry we collect your name, mobile number, the service you are interested in, your preferred time for a call and any message you write.
To prevent misuse of the form we store a one-way encrypted (hashed) form of your IP address. We do not store the IP address itself.
If analytics is enabled, we collect anonymous usage information such as pages visited and clicks on the Call and WhatsApp buttons.

sections.title: Why we collect it
body: We use your details only to contact you about your enquiry and to provide the service you asked for.
We do not sell your information, and we do not use it for unrelated marketing.

sections.title: Who can see it
body: Your enquiry is visible only to authorised staff of Suvarnavarsha Gold. It is stored with our website hosting and email service providers, who process it on our behalf.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: We keep enquiry details only for as long as needed to respond to you and to meet our legal obligations, after which they are deleted.

sections.title: Your choices
body: You can ask us to correct or delete the information you have shared through this website. Call or WhatsApp us on +91 91567 81981 and we will act on your request.

sections.title: Contact
body: Suvarnavarsha Gold Ventures Pvt. Ltd., Second Floor – 239, VTP Altitude, Near Shell Petrol Pump, Dange Chowk, Pune – 411033, Maharashtra. Phone: +91 91567 81981.
